## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change and its boundary.

## Verification

- [ ] Correctness tests added or updated
- [ ] Applicable macOS tests/build run locally
- [ ] Generic iOS Simulator build run locally
- [ ] Visual review completed for UI changes
- [ ] Benchmark and measurement metadata included for performance changes
- [ ] No model weights, credentials, private paths, or signing material added
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`)
